name: Fantasy Analytics
summary: Nineteen seasons of a private league's history, normalized across platform IDs that change every year.

metrics.label: Seasons
metrics.source: private static archive aggregate FSA-E1: 19 manifest years, 2007-2025 inclusive; 2026 excluded; historical coverage, not live sync or proof of every scheduled game

metrics.label: Matchups
metrics.source: private static archive aggregate FSA-E2: 1,724 manifest-referenced normalized matchup rows through 2025, also 1,724 distinct season/week/unordered team-ID pairs; both-team game logs and raw copies excluded

metrics.label: Franchises
metrics.source: private archive homepage baseline 'Unique franchises'; retained date and lower bound, not a fresh exact runtime total; FSA-E3 supplies corroborating static historical stable-identity evidence

metrics.label: Archive JSON files
metrics.source: private static archive aggregate FSA-E4: 209 JSON files in the 19 season directories through 2025 plus two global registries; raw and normalized resources included, partial 2026 season directory excluded
